name: cloud-monitoring-chart-generation
description: >- Generates Google Cloud Monitoring Server-Driven UI (SDUI) Widget and XyChart Protocol Buffer textprotos from resolved PromQL queries. Use when: - Generating valid google.monitoring.dashboard.v1.Widget textprotos, containing PrometheusQuery datasets, for use with the Cloud Monitoring Dashboards API, gcloud CLI, or declarative dashboard definitions. - Synthesizing Server-Driven UI (SDUI) widget titles, axis labels, and plot types for Prometheus queries. Don't use for: - Metric discovery or Prom
author: google
summary_zh: 将已解析的 PromQL 查询生成 Google Cloud Monitoring 图表配置，适合通过 API、gcloud 或声明式定义创建监控仪表盘。
